Your Language Analyst & Expert Witness

Specialist linguistic expertise when language becomes evidence.

Dr Luna Filipovic has over 2 decades of academic expertise spanning the UK, USA and Europe, backed by a PhD in Linguistics from the University of Cambridge and postdoctoral training in Psychology from University College London. Dr. Filipovic bases her consultancy on the latest empirical research in the field, much of which she has conducted herself with international collaborators. She is the author of 4 books, 5 edited volumes and over 50 academic articles. Explore the research base here ↗.
